/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: Humble Beginnings
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionEn: Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionZh: 不要惧怕贫穷。贫穷是能激起甜美欲望的痛苦土壤。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: To The City
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionEn: Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionZh: 财富不会眷顾懒惰的人。停滞等于死亡。要不断前行。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: What Right Do They Have?
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionEn: Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionZh: 嫉妒吧。觊觎吧。然后拿走你想要的东西。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: The Taking
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionEn: Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionZh: 欺骗是智慧之剑。学聪明点。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: Crawling Back
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionEn: Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionZh: 当心那个懒惰的人，他会麻痹你，让你变得像以前一样懒惰。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: The Gemstone
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionEn: Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionZh: 知足就意味着懒惰。欲望会激发实际行动。滋养所有的欲望。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: Giving Back
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Charity is power. More charity is more power.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionEn: Charity is power. More charity is more power.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionZh: 给予是力量。更多的给予就是更大的力量。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: Bury The Past
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionEn: Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionZh: 避免多愁善感。这是制约懒惰之人的弱点。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: A New Empire
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: Fulfill desire and others will. Follow.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionEn: Fulfill desire and others will. Follow.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionZh: 当你能满足欲望，他人会，蜂拥追随。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.name: We Are Corpus
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.description: We are Desire. Ours is the grasping golden hand. We. Are. Corpus.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/CorpusGreed.descriptionEn: We are Desire. Ours is the grasping golden hand. We. Are. Corpus.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Hall.description: You can almost feel the beast growling, beckoning you closer. Place it in a spot of honor, settle in, and listen to the story its gaze seems ready to tell.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Hall.descriptionEn: You can almost feel the beast growling, beckoning you closer. Place it in a spot of honor, settle in, and listen to the story its gaze seems ready to tell.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Hall.descriptionZh: 你几乎能感觉到那野兽在咆哮，在召唤你走近。把它放在一个荣誉之地，静坐下来，聆听它目光中准备诉说的故事。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Lychnus
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: This delicate Entrati design's slender metal arm holds a subtle blue flame in a state of perfect equipoise.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionEn: This delicate Entrati design's slender metal arm holds a subtle blue flame in a state of perfect equipoise.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionZh: 这件英择谛精巧设计的细长金属臂，以一种完美平衡的状态，托举着一团微妙的蓝色火焰。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Rolizor
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: Natural infested forms combine in an eye-catching piece that recalls the singular landscape of Deimos.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionEn: Natural infested forms combine in an eye-catching piece that recalls the singular landscape of Deimos.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionZh: 感染的自然形态融合在一件夺目的作品内，让人联想到火卫二的独特景观。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Glynort
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: Add the perfect infested highlight to any room with this expertly cast decorative piece.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionEn: Add the perfect infested highlight to any room with this expertly cast decorative piece.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionZh: 通过这件专业铸造的装饰品来为任意房间增添完美的感染特色。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Sprongi
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: Sneak in this stand-out accent piece to give your ship’s interior a unique flair.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionEn: Sneak in this stand-out accent piece to give your ship’s interior a unique flair.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionZh: 悄然拿出这件杰出的装饰品，来为你的飞船内部带来一丝独特的风格。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Spilosect
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: This insectoid plant’s hardy disposition makes it a great, low-maintenance addition to any space.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionEn: This insectoid plant’s hardy disposition makes it a great, low-maintenance addition to any space.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionZh: 这种类昆虫植物的顽强性格，使其对任意空间来说都是一种绝佳的易养护的装饰品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Groptic
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: Beauty and strangeness blend in this distinctive tendrilled houseplant.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionEn: Beauty and strangeness blend in this distinctive tendrilled houseplant.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionZh: 集美丽与珍奇为一身的独特卷须室内植物。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Veforg
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: This bioluminescent plant is sure to brighten up any dark corner in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionEn: This bioluminescent plant is sure to brighten up any dark corner in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionZh: 这种生物发光植物一定会照亮你轨道飞行器中的任何黑暗角落。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Ansophys
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: The functional elegance of Orokin design makes this a versatile piece for storage or display.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionEn: The functional elegance of Orokin design makes this a versatile piece for storage or display.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionZh: 源自奥罗金设计的优雅实用性，使其成为可用作储存或展示的多功能工艺品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Kybus
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: Evoking the timeless classicism of the Orokin era, the Kybus makes a great base or table.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionEn: Evoking the timeless classicism of the Orokin era, the Kybus makes a great base or table.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionZh: 唤起奥罗金时代永恒的古典主义，绘玉台是一个很不错的底座或桌子。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.name: Auroron
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.description: With its antiqued metal and delicate gold accents, this Orokin floor piece adds grace and style to any room.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionEn: With its antiqued metal and delicate gold accents, this Orokin floor piece adds grace and style to any room.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Deimos/Lise.descriptionZh: 通过使用古式金属和精致的金色装饰，这件奥罗金地面装饰可以为任意房间增添典雅和格调。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DogDays2024.descriptionZh: 让你的脏地板见识地狱般的清洁，为你的轨道飞行器增添硬核风格。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DogDays2024.name: Dog Days WAR Display
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DogDays2024.description: We've got two words for ya: Soak it!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DogDays2024.descriptionEn: We've got two words for ya: Soak it!

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DogDays2025.name: Dog Days "Hang Loose" Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DogDays2025.description: Ride the waves with Yareli. Beverage not included.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DogDays2025.descriptionEn: Ride the waves with Yareli. Beverage not included.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DogDays2025.descriptionZh: 和 Yareli 一起乘风破浪。饮料不包含在内。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DomsFinalDr.name: Aged Claret of DeNas
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DomsFinalDr.description: A claret with notes of golden sunlight. The Leverian’s history of the Warframe Ash brings into question whether blood runs thicker than fine wine.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DomsFinalDr.nameZh: 德纳斯的陈年红葡萄酒
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DomsFinalDr.descriptionEn: A claret with notes of golden sunlight. The Leverian’s history of the Warframe Ash brings into question whether blood runs thicker than fine wine.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/DomsFinalDr.descriptionZh: 散发着金色阳光气息的红葡萄酒。Ash 在莱弗博物馆的历史不由让人质疑鲜血是否比红酒更加浓郁。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Domi.name: Duviri Palace Throne
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Domi.description: A throne inspired by descriptions of the king's palace in Tales of Duviri.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Domi.descriptionEn: A throne inspired by descriptions of the king's palace in Tales of Duviri.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Domi.descriptionZh: 一个王座，灵感来自《双衍王境故事集》中对王宫的描述。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Calculum
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: An ingenious device for arithmetic. Used to keep track of a shopkeeper’s sales, a kingdom’s wealth, or the seemingly endless spiral of time.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionEn: An ingenious device for arithmetic. Used to keep track of a shopkeeper’s sales, a kingdom’s wealth, or the seemingly endless spiral of time.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionZh: 一个精巧的算术装置。用来记录店主的销售、王境的财富，或者看似无穷无尽的时间螺旋。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Hand Spa
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Duviri citizens are expected to keep clean at all times, in case Thrax’s gaze should fall upon them.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionEn: Duviri citizens are expected to keep clean at all times, in case Thrax’s gaze should fall upon them.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionZh: 双衍王境的公民必须时刻保持干净，以防士魂大帝的目光落在他们身上。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Mortis Stela
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: A replica of the cryptic monument that overshadows the many graves of Duviri.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionEn: A replica of the cryptic monument that overshadows the many graves of Duviri.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionZh: 掩盖双衍王境众多坟墓的神秘墓碑复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Theater Seat
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Ideal for appreciating Bombastine's performances. Cushioned to avoid uncomfortable posterior numbness.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionEn: Ideal for appreciating Bombastine's performances. Cushioned to avoid uncomfortable posterior numbness.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionZh: 非常适合欣赏蓬蓬士君的表演。有缓冲，以避免久坐的麻木不适。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Senate Seat
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: The style of chair that would be occupied by Duviri’s elected government, if it had one.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionEn: The style of chair that would be occupied by Duviri’s elected government, if it had one.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionZh: 如果双衍王境的民选政府真实存在，那么一定用的是这种风格的座椅。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Hay Bale
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Standard fodder for the Kaithes of Duviri, doubling as a humble bed for the weary laborer.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionEn: Standard fodder for the Kaithes of Duviri, doubling as a humble bed for the weary laborer.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Footstool
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Even the lowest Duviri citizen may need to reach a high spot from time to time.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionZh: 即使是最底层的双衍王境公民，时不时也需要到达一些高度。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Repast Table
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: A sturdy table on which to enjoy the nutritious dole of simple grains which Thrax’s generosity has blessed you with.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionZh: 一张坚固的桌子，在上面你可以享受由士魂大帝慷慨赐予的营养丰富的简单谷物。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Lectern
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Ideal for lecturing, preaching, or reading magnificent poetic compositions to a crowd who does not understand or appreciate them.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionZh: 是向不理解或不懂得欣赏的凡夫俗子们演讲、布教或诵读宏伟的诗歌作品的理想选择。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Scales
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Used to weigh out meager, everyday goods by meager, everyday merchants.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionZh: 用来给普通商人称量微不足道的日常物品。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Fainting Couch
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: For those times when turning into an Orowyrm is not an option.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionEn: For those times when turning into an Orowyrm is not an option.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionZh: 适用于无法变成奥金魇龙的时候。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Modesty Screen
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.description: Thrax has, grudgingly, allowed his citizens the use of these screens for the preservation of personal modesty. There are some places where even his exalted eyes have no business peering.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.name: Duviri Clerical Desk

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Duviri/Duvi.descriptionZh: 用这张精美的双衍王境书桌，反复起草没完没了的官僚文书。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: Feathers of memory, lovingly collected. The gift of self, immortalized in motes of steadfast light.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionEn: Feathers of memory, lovingly collected. The gift of self, immortalized in motes of steadfast light.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Heurodis Decoration

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Stay Together Display
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: This display celebrates the best of both worlds, and the worst of each. United or divided, they are two sides of the same whole.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionEn: This display celebrates the best of both worlds, and the worst of each. United or divided, they are two sides of the same whole.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionZh: 这个展示图既展现了两种文化的优点，也揭露了它们的缺点。无论团结还是分裂，它们都是同一个整体的两面。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Orion Alone Display
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: This display honors Orion, the burning heart. Schooled in vengeance, the only love he knows is death.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionEn: This display honors Orion, the burning heart. Schooled in vengeance, the only love he knows is death.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionZh: 这个展示图是为了纪念 Orion，他拥有一颗燃烧的心。他从小就被复仇所熏陶，他唯一懂得的爱就是死亡。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Sirius Alone Display
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: This display honors Sirius, the lonely star. Raised in shadow. Trained with dignity.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionEn: This display honors Sirius, the lonely star. Raised in shadow. Trained with dignity.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionZh: 这个展示图在致敬 Sirius，一颗孤独的星。他在阴影中成长，在尊严中成长。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Alone Portrait
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: A portrait of the Stalker forging his lonely path.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionEn: A portrait of the Stalker forging his lonely path.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionZh: 追猎者孤独地踏上征程的肖像。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: United Portrait
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: An embrace of lovers, divided by war.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionEn: An embrace of lovers, divided by war.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionZh: 紧密相拥的恋人，他们在战争中被拆散。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.name: Protector Portrait
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.description: A portrait of the Stalker: once a dark avenger, now a devoted father.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionEn: A portrait of the Stalker: once a dark avenger, now a devoted father.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JadeShadows.descriptionZh: 追猎者的肖像：曾是黑暗的复仇者，现在是一位尽职的父亲。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JavisExperi.name: Javi Evolution Scrawling
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JavisExperi.description: Become a student of Javi. This evolution scrawling is based on Drusus Leverian's records of Lavos.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2HunhowSt.description: Reality is merely a point of view in this lenticular display illustrating the conflict between what is and what could have been.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2HunhowSt.descriptionZh: 在这个变图展示图中，现实仅仅是一种视角，它展现了现实与可能之间的冲突。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MAshPost.name: Cloning 101 Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MAshPost.description: Many problems can be solved by the ability to be in two places at once. Many other problems are created this way. Faint traces of Efervon imply the artist may have had a mechanical hand.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MAshPost.descriptionEn: Many problems can be solved by the ability to be in two places at once. Many other problems are created this way. Faint traces of Efervon imply the artist may have had a mechanical hand.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MAshPost.descriptionZh: 如果能同时身处两地，许多问题便迎刃而解。但这种能力同时也带来了许多其他问题。微弱的艾弗旺痕迹暗示，这位艺术家可能有一只机械手。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MGarudaP.name: Relationship Goals Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/JS2MGarudaP.description: For the expression of extremely normal and measured feelings toward the object of your affection. Faint traces of Efervon imply the artist may have had a mechanical hand.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropMa.name: Dax's Shawzin

The ancient ballad, 'Smiles from Juran,' is one of the few known examples of music composed for this instrument. Play this instrument by equipping and using the included Shawzin Emote.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: Long ago this Shawzin was played to entertain the Orokin court. Now its enduring music shall celebrate your victories.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.descriptionZh: 很久以前，这把三线琴是奥罗金宫廷的御用乐器。而现在，它那悠扬的曲调，将为你的胜利而奏响。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.name: Lizzie
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: For some favored Tenno, Flare's infested guitar has consented to be played like any other instrument. Handle with respect - and caution.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.descriptionEn: For some favored Tenno, Flare's infested guitar has consented to be played like any other instrument. Handle with respect - and caution.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.descriptionZh: 对于某些受青睐的 Tenno 来说，弗莱尔的感染吉他已同意像其他乐器一样被演奏。请怀着敬意——并小心使用。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.name: Iridos Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: A familiar sound with a distinctive new look.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.descriptionEn: A familiar sound with a distinctive new look.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.descriptionZh: 一个熟悉的声音配上一款与众不同的新外观。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.name: Kira's Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: This instrument belonged to a much-loved member of the Holdfasts, who would often cheer up her companions with it.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.descriptionEn: This instrument belonged to a much-loved member of the Holdfasts, who would often cheer up her companions with it.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.descriptionZh: 这件乐器曾属于坚守者中一位深受喜爱的成员，她经常会弹奏它来鼓舞同伴。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.name: Void's Song Shawzin
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.description: Kira played her shawzin to uplift the spirits of Zariman crewmembers. Her song and her memory live on in the Void.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.descriptionEn: Kira played her shawzin to uplift the spirits of Zariman crewmembers. Her song and her memory live on in the Void.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSh.descriptionZh: 吉拉演奏她的三线琴来振奋扎里曼船员的精神。她的歌声和记忆永存于虚空之中。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.name: Simaris Offerings Replica Console
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.description: Hunter, behold the rewards of your work in Synthesis. A non-functioning Simaris console decoration for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.nameZh: Simaris 声望奖励复刻控制台
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.descriptionEn: Hunter, behold the rewards of your work in Synthesis. A non-functioning Simaris console decoration for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.descriptionZh: 猎者，看看你结合仪式的成果吧。这是一个可以装点你轨道飞行器的失效的 Simaris 控制台装饰。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.name: Simaris Research Replica Console
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.description: In Synthesis all things may be known, Hunter. A non-functioning Simaris console decoration for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.descriptionEn: In Synthesis all things may be known, Hunter. A non-functioning Simaris console decoration for your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSi.descriptionZh: 在结合仪式中所有的东西或许都是已知的，猎者。这是一个可以装点你轨道飞行器的失效的 Simaris 控制台装饰。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.name: Sukshma Eleva
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.description: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.descriptionEn: This exquisitely designed decoration adds luxury and class to any Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.descriptionZh: 这款精心设计的装饰给轨道飞行器来去了奢华感和经典的气质。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.name: Tharros & Axios Prime Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.description: The exalted armaments of Styanax Prime, ready for place of pride in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.nameZh: 豪勇 & 崇敬 Prime 装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.descriptionEn: The exalted armaments of Styanax Prime, ready for place of pride in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.descriptionZh: Styanax Prime 的显赫军备，随时准备在轨道飞行器上占据荣耀的位置。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.name: Tharros & Axios Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.description: You will honor Styanax when you display these cherished armaments.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.descriptionEn: You will honor Styanax when you display these cherished armaments.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSt.descriptionZh: 通过展示这些珍贵的军备来向 Styanax 致敬。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSU.name: Solaris Industrial Strip
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSU.description: Corpus-produced posters and signboards reminding Solaris workers of rights and safety protocols. Report nonconformists! Life is Profit, Profit is Life!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSU.descriptionEn: Corpus-produced posters and signboards reminding Solaris workers of rights and safety protocols. Report nonconformists! Life is Profit, Profit is Life!
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropSU.descriptionZh: 由 Corpus 出产的海报及布告板，提醒 Solaris 工人的权利及安全措施。一律举报不遵奉者！人生是利益，利益就是人生！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropWo.name: Steadfast Ulfrun Bust
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropWo.description: Display this statue in honor of Ulfrun's strength.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/LisetPropWo.descriptionZh: 这尊雕像用以纪念乌尔佛伦的力量。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OstronHeadS.name: Telamon Dance of Death
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OstronHeadS.description: A moment frozen in time, gruesomely magnificent. This harrowing piece was found among a debris field that made Drusus Leverian reconsider legends about the Warframe Atlas.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OstronHeadS.descriptionEn: A moment frozen in time, gruesomely magnificent. This harrowing piece was found among a debris field that made Drusus Leverian reconsider legends about the Warframe Atlas.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OstronHeadS.descriptionZh: 时光凝结在这一瞬间，美的令人毛骨悚然。这件惊世骇俗的作品是在一片碎石区发现的，这让德枢·莱弗重新考虑了关于 Atlas 的一些传说。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OwlOrdisSta.name: Ordis Reified Statue
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OwlOrdisSta.description: A decorative statue that recognizes steadfast loyalty in an ever-changing universe.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OwlOrdisSta.descriptionEn: A decorative statue that recognizes steadfast loyalty in an ever-changing universe.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/OwlOrdisSta.descriptionZh: 一个装饰性的雕像，代表着在千变万化的宇宙中矢志不渝的忠诚。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/ParazonPost.name: Parazon Poster
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/ParazonPost.description: Mercy Or Convert? A poster for your Orbiter.

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/ParazonPost.descriptionZh: 怜悯之击还是感化？一张给轨道飞行器的海报。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/PedistalPri.name: Pedestal Prime
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/PedistalPri.description: Behold, the singular vision of a great artist and the life’s work of a master craftsmen. An artifact so refined, so imbued with the finest material that it has no equal in this system. This is the plinth that all others aspire to be. This is Pedestal Prime.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/PedistalPri.descriptionEn: Behold, the singular vision of a great artist and the life’s work of a master craftsmen. An artifact so refined, so imbued with the finest material that it has no equal in this system. This is the plinth that all others aspire to be. This is Pedestal Prime.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/PedistalPri.descriptionZh: 看吶，来自伟大艺术家的卓越眼光和手艺大师的毕生杰作。这一款精心雕琢、使用最佳材质的工艺品，在这个星系都无可匹及。这就是基座中的王者，这就是基座 Prime。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.descriptionZh: 当打碟王一开口，全世界都在倾听！这位记者也不例外。当打碟王说'我们之所以组成这个团体，是因为我们都热爱音乐'时，线上时代的所有成员都点头表示同意。这才是团队目标！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.description: Drillbit keeps it 100% real, as always. No sugarcoating here. He told us straight up, 'Once you get a taste of fame, you're hooked.' Honesty like that is why we love him!

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Plushies/Pl.descriptionZh: 钻头小子一如既往地保持百分百的真实。从不讲虚话。他直截了当地告诉我们，'一旦你尝到了名气的滋味，你就会上瘾。'正是这种坦率让我们如此喜爱他！

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUBoo.name: Rail Agent Manifest Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUBoo.description: Logs of an unknown rail agent. A quaint addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUBoo.nameZh: 航道特工货物清单装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUBoo.descriptionEn: Logs of an unknown rail agent. A quaint addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUBoo.descriptionZh: 一位无名航道特工的日志。给着陆器平添了一份古雅。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCon.name: Solaris Cargo Crate Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCon.description: Conforms to standard retention bracket specs for all make of rail tractor. And, coincidentally, your lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCon.nameZh: 索拉里斯货物储存箱装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCon.descriptionEn: Conforms to standard retention bracket specs for all make of rail tractor. And, coincidentally, your lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCon.descriptionZh: 符合标准的滞留支架，适用于各类航道牵引机。并且，巧合的是，也适用于你的着陆器。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCoo.name: Fortuna-Model Coolant Pod Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCoo.description: For sample containment and transfer. Adds a rugged look to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCoo.nameZh: 福尔图娜型冷却舱装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCoo.descriptionEn: For sample containment and transfer. Adds a rugged look to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUCoo.descriptionZh: 用于样本的储存和运输。给任何着陆器增加了粗犷的外观。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.name: Solaris Food Box Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.description: Those Solaris still utilizing traditional ingestion methods (often children) take sustenance from foods such as these energy bars. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.descriptionEn: Those Solaris still utilizing traditional ingestion methods (often children) take sustenance from foods such as these energy bars. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.descriptionZh: 那些索拉里斯人仍然使用着传统的进食方式（主要是小孩），从比如能量棒这样的食物中获取养分。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加生活气息。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.name: Solaris Food Can Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.description: Those Solaris still utilizing traditional ingestion methods (often children) take sustenance from foods such as processed fish. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.descriptionEn: Those Solaris still utilizing traditional ingestion methods (often children) take sustenance from foods such as processed fish. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.descriptionZh: 那些索拉里斯人仍然使用着传统的进食方式（主要是小孩），从比如能量棒这样的食物中获取养分。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加生活气息。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.name: Solaris Canteen Tray Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.description: A meal tray for a Solaris citizen still utilizing traditional ingestion methods. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.nameZh: 索拉里斯餐厅托盘装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.descriptionEn: A meal tray for a Solaris citizen still utilizing traditional ingestion methods. Place about your lander to give it that lived-in feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUFoo.descriptionZh: 仍以传统方式进食的索拉里斯市民所使用的食物托盘。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加生活气息。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.name: Solaris Supply Cart Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.description: Favored by rig jockeys for efficient transportation of parts and supplies. Give your lander that seat-of-your-pants scoundrel feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.nameZh: 索拉里斯补给货车装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.descriptionEn: Favored by rig jockeys for efficient transportation of parts and supplies. Give your lander that seat-of-your-pants scoundrel feel.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.descriptionZh: 受到技工的喜爱，可以有效地运输零件和补给。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以增加一种'老子的专属座驾'的感觉。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.name: Localized Air Purifier Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.description: Off-gassed coolant can be fatal to those with organic respiratory systems. Add this decoration to your lander to evoke the smells of Fortuna.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.descriptionEn: Off-gassed coolant can be fatal to those with organic respiratory systems. Add this decoration to your lander to evoke the smells of Fortuna.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.descriptionZh: 废气中的冷却液对于有机呼吸系统是致命的。把这个放在你的着陆器上可以唤起福尔图娜的气息。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.name: Solaris Supply Rack Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.description: A common sight on various decks and in the sumps, these racks allow much-needed tools and parts to remain within arm's reach. A tasteful addition to any engine room.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.descriptionEn: A common sight on various decks and in the sumps, these racks allow much-needed tools and parts to remain within arm's reach. A tasteful addition to any engine room.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUSup.descriptionZh: 在多种甲板和污水池中常见，这种架子使得许多常用工具和零件触手可及。放置在引擎室中别有一番风味。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.name: Solaris Sawchain Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.description: Can be used as metal-cutter or filer. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.descriptionEn: Can be used as metal-cutter or filer. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.descriptionZh: 可以被用于金属切割或锉修。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.name: Solaris Motherwrench Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.description: Primarily used in the opening and closing of coolant sluices. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.descriptionEn: Primarily used in the opening and closing of coolant sluices. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.descriptionZh: 主要用于打开或关闭冷却液水闸。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.name: Solaris Diagnostic Tool Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.description: Useful for taking atmospheric readings and measuring the thermal properties of coolant. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.nameZh: 索拉里斯诊断工具装饰
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.descriptionEn: Useful for taking atmospheric readings and measuring the thermal properties of coolant. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.descriptionZh: 测量大气读数和冷却液热性能时很有用。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.name: Solaris Sampler Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.description: Used by geologists, technicians, plumbers, hydrologists, terraforming engineers, slurry monitors, sumpers, crud divers... A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.descriptionEn: Used by geologists, technicians, plumbers, hydrologists, terraforming engineers, slurry monitors, sumpers, crud divers... A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTec.descriptionZh: 被地质学家、技师、水管工、水文学家、地球化改造工程师、泥浆监视员、污水池操作工、污垢深潜员等等使用。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.name: Solaris Toolbox Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.description: For when you really need that thermal prong within manipulator's reach. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.descriptionEn: For when you really need that thermal prong within manipulator's reach. A handy addition to any lander.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.descriptionZh: 当你非常需要操纵器可以抓取那个热能探针时很有用。着陆器中的实用装备。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.name: Solaris Supplies Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.description: Everything you need to refill nutrient canisters, recharge tools and protect what organics you have remaining. How you present it in your Lander is up to you.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.descriptionEn: Everything you need to refill nutrient canisters, recharge tools and protect what organics you have remaining. How you present it in your Lander is up to you.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUToo.descriptionZh: 加满营养罐、工具充电、保护你剩下的有机部分，你需要的应有尽有。至于你如何将之展现在着陆器上就由你决定了。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTru.name: Widebody Ore Transport Decoration
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTru.description: Minature model of a commonly-used mining vehicle. The kids seem to like it. Why not add it to your lounge area?
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTru.descriptionEn: Minature model of a commonly-used mining vehicle. The kids seem to like it. Why not add it to your lounge area?
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/Venus/SUTru.descriptionZh: 常用采矿车辆的缩小模型。小孩子们看上去很喜欢。为何不把它加入你的休息区域呢？

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotA.descriptionEn: The grooves in this vase were shaped by the careful hands of artist Bren Terrasiam.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotA.descriptionZh: 这个花瓶上的凹槽是由艺术家布伦·泰拉西姆精心塑造的。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotB.name: Gallixware Kaolin Bowl
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotB.description: The flowing pattern Bren Terrasiam painted onto this bowl is meant to promote serenity.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotB.descriptionEn: The flowing pattern Bren Terrasiam painted onto this bowl is meant to promote serenity.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotB.descriptionZh: 布伦·泰拉西姆在这个碗上所画的流线图案旨在宣扬静心之道。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotC.name: Gallixware Bisque Amphora
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotC.description: Bren Terrasiam fashioned custom amphorae for elite Orokin who stored and served fine wine with style.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotC.descriptionEn: Bren Terrasiam fashioned custom amphorae for elite Orokin who stored and served fine wine with style.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotC.descriptionZh: 布伦·泰拉西姆为奥罗金精英们定制的双耳瓶，他们以别具一格的方式储存和伺候美酒。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotD.name: Gallixware Coiled Vase
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotD.description: Bren Terrasiam lovingly fashioned and stacked clay coils to form this vase.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotD.descriptionEn: Bren Terrasiam lovingly fashioned and stacked clay coils to form this vase.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotD.descriptionZh: 布伦·泰拉西姆用匠心和层叠的泥条盘筑成这个花瓶。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotE.name: Gallixware Studded Vase
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotE.description: Bren Terrasiam was renowned for his precision. The uniformity of this vase was typical in his fine ceramics.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotE.descriptionEn: Bren Terrasiam was renowned for his precision. The uniformity of this vase was typical in his fine ceramics.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotE.descriptionZh: 布伦·泰拉西姆以精细着称。这个花瓶的均匀性是他精美陶瓷的典型特征。

/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotF.name: Gallixware Frit Plate
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotF.description: Orokin ceramic artist, Bren Terrasiam employed an old world glazing technique to give this plate a lustrous finish. Elites of the day admired his mastery of the ancient arts.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotF.descriptionEn: Orokin ceramic artist, Bren Terrasiam employed an old world glazing technique to give this plate a lustrous finish. Elites of the day admired his mastery of the ancient arts.
/Lotus/Types/Items/ShipDecos/XakuPotF.descriptionZh: 奥罗金陶瓷艺术家布伦·泰拉西姆采用旧世界的上釉技术为这个盘子赋予光泽。当时的精英们钦佩他对古代艺术的精通。
